reviews.text:
This was our first time at an agility course and this place turned out to be a great choice. It was easy to get in, the equipment is great, we just had to be creative when putting together the tasks.
All three of us really enjoyed it.
We will definitely be back!
Great place although a bit hot in the summer
We love it. You can go anytime, you don't have to adapt and you can be completely yourself. There are all kinds of equipment. The rental is at a great price. Parking is free.

The place is completely easy to find, you only need to enter the name of the place into the GPS, not the address, because the entire street is numbered, which is not the place's fault. The access is totally modern, because if the gate is locked on the farm, the owner can open it remotely 24 hours a day, if you call, and he will respond within two minutes, even if he is on vacation. The door inside works with a code, nothing could be simpler than that :) no one is needed and those who are already experienced can just book, with the most modern system and go for training. The track inside is also equipped with the best equipment for the dog. Rubber ground + artificial grass protects the legs and the obstacles are the best. There is no heating, a fact, because the monthly cost would be about 2 million, it can be solved, but then the rental would be 20,000 / hour. Anyone who goes there to exercise will not be cold. On the other hand, there is no rain, no mud, and wind and scorching sun. You can't have everything in one place. There is also a standing heater, for those who are waiting, it is called infrared heating. So it is not true that there is no heating. I think it is fantastic that there is a place where you can be alone with your dog in peace and for example you do not have to worry about him running away or looking at someone else. It has a very good atmosphere and you can spend quality time with your dog and there is no place like this in the whole of Hungary 💕
Very well equipped agility hall. It's a pleasure to be here! It's cold in winter, those who don't work should dress up!

The best dog place in town, my border collie loves going here. The equipment is first class. As beginners, we received all the help we could during the training, Zsuzsi's guidance contributed to my dog ​​and I finishing the training in a good mood and tired. I recommend it to everyone who wants to spend quality time with their dog in a cultured environment.

Indoor, well-equipped place. There is the possibility to train alone and with an instructor, and also to train together with fellow dogs.
My hyperactive dog loves it, and we become an increasingly great team through training. 😍 …
